title: RISE Hedging Simulation
description: Simulation code and compact results comparing contract-specific implied-volatility Black-Scholes delta, plain Heston delta, and correlation-adjusted Heston hedging. The frozen version-2 protocol evaluates mean squared terminal hedging error after transaction costs under structural-parameter perturbations and discrete rebalancing. This initial release preserves the completed study and adds no new robustness analyses. Raw simulation outputs can be regenerated from the included code and configuration.
